bugs.text: sprite() calls r.split on rows that are already number arrays (SPR.playerCap) -> TypeError at load; the script stops, nothing renders, no input or loop (play-test pageerror, blank 300x150 canvas).
Title loop runs i<7 over the 6-char 'GALAGA'; text() receives undefined and throws on s.length every title frame.
FONT is built from the 7 rows of TITLES mapped to letters A-G; all other letters and every digit are undefined, so scores, HUD, STAGE/GAME OVER/READY text never render.
Canvas width/height never set and no scaling code: the canvas stays 300x150, not a scaled 224x288 playfield.
Fire checks G.keys.Space but keydown stores ' '; the player can never shoot.
bezP/bezV take 4 point args but are called with (pathObject, t) -> NaN positions for entering, diving, looping and challenge enemies.
Boss spawn group uses cols [3,4,5,6] but bosses are cols 0-3; 3 bosses stay 'waiting' forever, so a stage can never be cleared.
A single fighter has L/R inactive; collisions and drawPlayer only consider active halves, so the player is invisible and invulnerable.
Respawn sets mode 'ready', which neither update() nor render() handles -> permanent freeze after a death.
capturePlayer returns early for a single ship: tractor-beam capture, rescue and dual fighter never happen.
Boss hp is 1, so Boss Galaga dies in one hit and never changes colour.
Losing a ship never decrements G.ships and there are no extra-ship awards; game over is unreachable.
Challenge stage launches all 40 at once on one path; bonus/PERFECT shown but never added to the score.
The enemy explosion's two frames are identical.

summary: The file crashes at load (line 88 passes number arrays to a sprite() that calls split), so in the play-test it shows only a blank default 300x150 canvas: no title, no input, no loop. Even past that crash the code is deeply broken: the bitmap font is made from 7 rows of a title array so almost no text or digits can render, the title render throws, the canvas is never sized, Space never fires, every bezier path is called with the wrong arguments and yields NaN positions, three bosses never spawn so no stage can end, the single fighter is invisible and invulnerable, the respawn 'ready' mode freezes the game, and tractor-beam capture returns immediately. The outline (state object, update/render split, Web Audio sound set, fixed-step loop, Galaga-shaped feature list) resembles Galaga on paper, but almost none of it can work; it is not a playable Galaga clone.
